## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
The new setter should preserve the cache’s case-insensitive key contract before callers rely on it.

## Changes
Adds `Cache.set()` and raises the default TTL from 60 to 300 seconds, with round-trip and expiry tests. Tests were read, not run.

## Important
- app/cache.py:27 — correctness — Normalize mixed-case keys when writing — With `c.set("ALPHA", 1)`, both `c.get("ALPHA")` and `c.get("alpha")` return `None`. The setter stores the original key, while `get()` always looks up `key.lower()`. — Callers writing mixed-case keys cannot retrieve their cached values, breaking the cache’s documented case-insensitive behavior.
